title: Project Aurora – Monthly Status Report – February 2026
content:
Project: Aurora | Report Period: February 2026 | Owner: Jane Smith

OVERALL STATUS: AMBER

MILESTONE SUMMARY

- G3 Target: 20 February 2026 — CONDITIONAL PASS (formula stability and supplier lead times outstanding)
- G4 Target: 15 April 2026 — AT RISK if G3 conditions not resolved by 07 March

- Fill weight confirmed at 250ml — cost-per-unit target met

2. Supplier lead time confirmation outstanding (Sarah Chen, due 03 March) — blocks packaging dieline and PO
3. Fragrance variant scope change requested by Categories — impact assessment pending, governance board decision required
4. G3 governance board update slide overdue (Jane Smith) — to be completed immediately

OPEN ACTIONS: 5 | OVERDUE ACTIONS: 1 | COMPLETED ACTIONS: 3

NEXT PERIOD PRIORITIES
- Resolve all G3 conditional items by 07 March
- Complete fragrance variant impact assessment
- Prepare for G4 readiness review on 12 March
- Update ePPM with all current task statuses
